Should the histogram be normalized (probabilities) or absolute counts? The prompt says 'frequency' which can be ambiguous.
Is the range [0, 256) inclusive of 0 and exclusive of 256, meaning pixel value 255 is the last bin and value 256 is not allowed?
If the image is empty (0 pixels), should the histogram return all zeros or raise an exception?

Are pixel values outside [0, 255] (e.g., due to high dynamic range) clipped to this range, or should they cause an exception?
